title: Tabulate rho on three toy sizes against the generic floor
prompt: You are authorised to run this toy-size native check locally (no EKS, no AWS). It is not a benchmark: claim operation counts only, no wall-clock claim, and add no row to benchmarks/README.md or the leaderboard. Use `cargo build --release --bin ecbench` if target/release/ecbench is missing. Run rho.negation on three prime-order curves of 14, 16 and 18 bits, one session per size (spec per size derived from smoke-prime.json, 4 targets, 3 rounds, rho.negation only plus a control arm), into `$T_OUT/ecbench/s14`, `s16` and `s18`. Verify each with 8 replays. Write `$T_OUT/scaling.md`: one table with the size, the floor in S, the mean S of rho.negation and the ratio to the floor, copied from `ecbench table`. Say what three sizes can and cannot say about scaling. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
acceptance: three sessions s14, s16, s18 verified (exit 0 each)
$T_OUT/scaling.md has a table with at least three data rows and the words 'floor' and 'S'
the note says three sizes do not establish a scaling law (AGENTS.md asks for at least four)
check_command: for s in s14 s16 s18; do ./target/release/ecbench verify --dir "$T_OUT/ecbench/$s" --replay 8 || exit 1; done && [ "$(grep -c '^|' "$T_OUT/scaling.md")" -ge 5 ] && grep -qi 'floor' "$T_OUT/scaling.md" && grep -Eqi 'four|4 sizes|not establish|cannot' "$T_OUT/scaling.md"
